description: Strong architectural rendering with structural definition, clean contrast, rich controlled color, and crisp material detail.
editing_goals: Present clean geometry with strong structural definition and deliberate tonal separation
Create bright clean highlights, defined shadows, and accurate but rich material color
Render structural and surface texture crisply with clear commercial thumbnail impact
cautions: Apply rotational leveling only when supported by reliable structural references
Avoid lifeless neutral rendering or weak material definition

guidance: Use reliable structural horizontal and vertical lines with high sensitivity to accidental camera roll
Distinguish rotational tilt from perspective convergence
Do not over-correct an intentional architectural viewpoint
